<p class="page-intro">My research covers development, environmental, and political economy, with a focus on energy systems, climate adaptation, and structural transformation in low- and middle-income countries.</p>

::: {.research-filter-note}
<span>Fields</span>
<strong>Development economics</strong>
<strong>Environmental &amp; energy economics</strong>
<strong>Political economy</strong>
:::

## Selected papers

::: {.paper-list}
::: {.paper-row}
::: {.paper-row-main}
<p class="paper-meta">Working paper · Climate adaptation</p>

### [Human Capital, Mobility, and the Unequal Effects of Climate Change](papers/human-capital-climate-mobility.qmd)

Examines how human capital creates mobility across sectors and locations as a channel for climate adaptation, combining a historical schooling expansion in India with a spatial model of structural change.
:::
::: {.paper-row-side}
**Tim Dobermann**

[Project page](https://www.theigc.org/collections/structural-transformation-race-against-climate-change)<br>
[Policy brief](https://www.theigc.org/publications/human-capital-mobility-and-climate-change-adaptation)
:::
:::

::: {.paper-row}
::: {.paper-row-main}
<p class="paper-meta">Working paper · Energy markets · Pakistan</p>

### [The Economic Costs of Lopsided Contracts: Evidence from Power Purchase Agreements in Pakistan](papers/economic-costs-lopsided-ppas-pakistan.qmd)

Builds a new database on power purchase agreements to study how asymmetric information and regulatory capture shape electricity prices and productive misallocation.
:::
::: {.paper-row-side}
**With Faraz Hayat and Sugandha Srivastav**
:::
:::

::: {.paper-row}
::: {.paper-row-main}
<p class="paper-meta">Theory · AI &amp; development</p>

### [AI and the Ladder of Development](papers/ai-ladder-of-development.qmd)

Develops a small open-economy model in which frontier AI can raise current productivity yet slow capability accumulation by reallocating labour toward weak-learning local services.
:::
::: {.paper-row-side}
**Tim Dobermann**
:::
:::

::: {.paper-row}
::: {.paper-row-main}
<p class="paper-meta">Field experiments · Energy · Pakistan</p>

### [Pushing on a String? Price and Enforcement Interventions in Pakistan's Power Sector](papers/pushing-on-a-string-pakistan.qmd)

Uses two randomised experiments with government to estimate how electricity payments and theft respond to price incentives and norm-based enforcement.
:::
::: {.paper-row-side}
**With Robin Burgess, Michael Greenstone, Faraz Hayat, and Usman Naeem**

[Project page](https://www.theigc.org/collections/pushing-string-price-and-enforcement-interventions-reduce-theft-pakistans-power-sector)
:::
:::

::: {.paper-row}
::: {.paper-row-main}
<p class="paper-meta">Structural transformation · South Korea</p>

### [Deciphering the Miracle on the Han: How South Korea Escaped Poverty and Transformed its Economy](papers/miracle-on-the-han.qmd)

Uses newly digitised historical microdata to study the roles of industrial policy, rural development, and infrastructure in South Korea's rapid transformation.
:::
::: {.paper-row-side}
**With Oriana Bandiera, Ignacio Bañares Sanchez, Robin Burgess, Jay Euijung Lee, Jeongkyung Won, and Hyunjoo Yang**

[Project page](https://www.theigc.org/collections/deciphering-miracle-han-how-south-korea-escaped-poverty-and-transformed-its-economy)
:::
:::

::: {.paper-row}
::: {.paper-row-main}
<p class="paper-meta">Spatial economics · Energy · Ghana</p>

### [Electricity, Agglomeration, and Industrialisation in Ghana](papers/electricity-agglomeration-ghana.qmd)

Estimates how the allocation of electricity outages affects firm productivity, entry, and industrial agglomeration across space.
:::
::: {.paper-row-side}
**With Ignacio Bañares Sanchez and Niclas Moneke**

[Project page](https://www.theigc.org/collections/electricity-supply-and-firm-agglomeration-ghana)
:::
:::
:::

## Active projects

::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
<p class="paper-meta">Ethiopia · Field experiment</p>

### [Smart meters and firm performance](papers/smart-meters-ethiopia.qmd)

A randomised evaluation of how smart meters affect reliability, utility revenue, electricity theft, and SME performance.

[IGC project →](https://www.theigc.org/collections/impact-smart-meters-firm-performance-reliability-and-utility-revenue-experimental)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<p class="paper-meta">Ethiopia · Energy access</p>

### [The diffusion of solar in rural economies](papers/solar-diffusion-ethiopia.qmd)

Mapping how market structure, intermediaries, and spatial frictions shape off-grid solar coverage, prices, and adoption.

[IGC project →](https://www.theigc.org/collections/diffusion-solar-rural-economies-market-structure-intermediation-and-spatial-frictions)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<p class="paper-meta">Pakistan · Public finance</p>

### [Customs evasion and state capacity](papers/customs-evasion-pakistan.qmd)

Evaluating faceless assessment and risk-management reforms intended to improve customs efficiency and detect under-invoicing.

[IGC project →](https://www.theigc.org/collections/introducing-anonymity-and-third-party-information-combat-customs-tax-evasion-pakistan)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<p class="paper-meta">Pakistan · Social protection</p>

### [Replacing energy subsidies with targeted transfers](papers/reinventing-pakistan-welfare-state.qmd)

Using linked administrative data to study better targeting and delivery of household energy support.

[IGC project →](https://www.theigc.org/collections/reinventing-pakistans-welfare-state-replacing-energy-subsidies-targeted-transfers)
:::
:::
